initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to convert it into a nursery. The location is in Turin. I prefer properties near green spaces.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to convert it into a nursery. The location is in Turin. I prefer properties near green spaces.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Schools and educational activities' AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND green >= 89 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

scenario_definition.name: 2 omitted dimensions; intended use: Nursery; opt-out on Cb

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to convert it into a nursery for 45 children in Turin with at least 600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near green spaces.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a nursery.
clarifications.Cb: I have no requirement on building size, capacity or structural features.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near green spaces.

requirements.description: Prefers proximity to green spaces; meets or exceeds the 75th percentile (89.49).

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Schools and educational activities' AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND green >= 89 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
